thread:
emma: Quick heads-up — PR #412 (optimize-toolkit) is green but I noticed the SDK migration snippets are still v1. We should update snippets for `@redwood/sdk` v2 and fix the two dead links in the quantization section.
rahul: Thanks for catching. Which links are broken?
emma: The first is the quant profiles reference (404), second is an internal Example app link that points to the old repo path. I left inline comments on the PR.
miguel: I can handle the batching/cache code examples. For SDK v2 the client instantiation changed — new constructor is `new RedwoodClient({apiKey, region})` instead of `createClient()`.
olivia: FYI the Optimize toolkit page also references `auto_batch: true` in a YAML example; that flag was renamed to `batching.enabled` — will cause confusion.
rahul: For quant profiles, the JSON schema changed: `quant_type` -> `profile.type` and `bits` -> `profile.bits`. I'll update the text and add a short migration table.
emma: Awesome. Can we add a tiny snippet showing both the old and new shape? People search for "quant_profile migration" a lot.
miguel: Yep. Proposed snippet (will push to the PR):
```
# old (v1)
quant_type: q4_0
bits: 4

# new (v2)
profile:
  type: q4_0
  bits: 4
```
rahul: Perfect. Also include a note about compatibility: runtime will accept v1 shape for 30 days but recommend migrating.
olivia: I'll fix the YAML flag and the Example app link. Which repo path is current?
emma: Point to github.com/redwood-inference/example-optimize (new org path). I swapped the link in my comment.
docs-bot: Preview for PR #412: https://docs-preview.internal/pr/412 — staging build passed :white_check_mark:
miguel: Pushed batching/snippet changes to the branch and updated the SDK snippet to use `RedwoodClient`.
emma: I updated the PR description with the migration table and a one-liner about fallback acceptance window. Also added a small callout: "If you rely on auto-batching defaults, test latency after switching to `batching.enabled`".
rahul: I'll add a short sample for programmatic quant profile creation via the SDK v2 too:
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.optimize.createQuantProfile({
  model: 'vicuna-13b',
  profile: { type: 'q4_0', bits: 4 }
});
```
olivia: LGTM. After docs-bot preview shows the updated internal link works, we can merge.
emma: Thanks all — planning to merge after CI and one more tech review. @miguel can you quick-check the caching example?
miguel: Checked. One tiny correction to the example cache TTL (was 3600, should be 300). Pushed commit 7a3b2f9.
emma: Great. I'll merge when preview is green. :thumbsup:
rahul: Leaving a follow-up issue to sweep other Optimize pages for old SDK shapes.
emuel: (typo) — ignore.
docs-bot: PR #412 merged by emma at 1769156989 :rocket:
